change: Cached input went from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. The price of a cache write did not change.

The price became $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, which OpenAI gives as 20% lower for input and 33% lower for output. OpenAI calls it promotional pricing, available at least until 21 November 2026.
The 1 million token window became generally available at the standard price, so a long prompt no longer costs more per token.
